SPECIMEN TYPE: Peripheral blood (EDTA)

TEST PERFORMED: DNA Extraction and Storage

METHODOLOGY:
Genomic DNA was extracted from peripheral blood using standard column-based purification methods. DNA quality was assessed by spectrophotometry (A260/A280 ratio) and quantification performed using fluorometric analysis.

RESULTS:
DNA successfully extracted from blood sample
DNA Concentration: 125 ng/μL
A260/A280 ratio: 1.85
Total yield: 62.5 μg

DNA has been aliquoted and stored at -80°C for future testing as requested.

COMMENTS:
No genetic testing has been performed at this time. The extracted DNA is available for future molecular genetic testing upon request. Please contact the laboratory with specific testing requirements.

DISCLAIMERS:
• Sample identification is based on information provided at the time of collection. The laboratory cannot guarantee the identity of the patient from whom the sample was obtained.
• Stated family relationships cannot be verified and are based on information provided.
• These results should be interpreted in the context of clinical findings and family history. Genetic counseling is recommended.
• DNA quality may degrade over time. Re-extraction may be necessary for future testing depending on storage duration and test requirements.
